title: Upper bound for the circuit compression rate
statement: For natural numbers $w,\ell,r$ with $w>0$ and $\ell>0$, the circuit compression rate $\frac{1}{10w}\left(\frac{1}{10\ell}\right)^r$ is at most $1$.
